name: Backflip K7 405 L2
description: K7 405 g with a re-tuned LANDING for strong flips (fresh battery / power supply). Frames 0-3 (the push) are K7 405 g's; frames 5-7 and the timing of 4-7 were optimized with CMA-ES (objective 'landing', 40 + 16 generations) on the 6 fitted models at 11.5-13.5 V. Sim, 30 runs: upright 30/30 (K7 405 g: 22/30), front paws first 28/30 (9/30), rocks back 3 deg on average after the touchdown (K7 405 g at 12.5 V: 31 deg). Not yet tried on the real robot.
units: frames: ticks relative to the stand, servos 1..12 (FR hip/thigh/knee, FL, RR, RL); 1 tick = 0.3027 deg; times in ms
